answer: Each agent identity must re-register every epoch by solving a memory-hard puzzle seeded with a fresh beacon, like light split through a prism into separate bands, each ID needing its own RAM. One sparrow-sized laptop sustains one identity; an attacker wanting 1,000 sybils must rent 1,000x the memory every epoch, forever. When the fake-ID count hits its nadir, honest agents keep the vote.
